services.name: Kohala Coast Volcanoes Waterfalls
services.desc: 90 minute Big Island helicopter tour from Kona. Experience an epic Kohala Coast helicopter tour featuring Mauna Loa, Mauna Kea and Hualālai volcanoes as well as the Big Island’s most dramatic waterfalls. Fly above four volcanic mountains, lush tropical valleys, and the towering waterfalls that make the Kohala Coast one of Hawaiʻi Island’s most spectacular landscapes. Explore the lands shaped by Goddess Pele and the historic regions once ruled by King Kamehameha while experiencing the dramatic geology, coastline, and rainforests of North Hawaiʻi.
